{"id":1850380053,"question_id":390,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"7 months, 2 weeks","timestamp":1765214825,"status":12,"status_display":"Memory Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1850380053/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Elimination Game","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    void byrec(vector<int>& vec, int& ans, bool isLeft) {\n        int n = vec.size();\n        \n        // Base case: Only one element remains\n        if (n == 1) {\n            ans = vec[0];\n            return;\n        }\n\n        vector<int>new_vec;\n\n        if(isLeft == true) \n        {\n            for(int i = 1; i < n; i += 2) \n            {\n                new_vec.push_back(vec[i]);\n            }\n        } \n        else \n        {\n            int start_index = (n % 2 == 0) ? 0 : 1;\n            \n            for(int i = start_index; i < n; i += 2) \n            {\n                new_vec.push_back(vec[i]);\n            }\n        }\n        //call with the new vector and the opposite direction\n        byrec(new_vec, ans, !isLeft);\n    }\n    \n    int lastRemaining(int n) {\n        if (n == 1) return 1;\n\n        vector<int>vec;\n        for(int i = 1; i <= n; i++) vec.push_back(i);\n\n        int ans = 0;\n        byrec(vec, ans, true);\n        return ans;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"elimination-game","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1277}
